rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as a condition:time interaction and specifies a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time with time as a 4-level factor, explicit reference levels, coefficient naming, BH at a stated alpha, and apeglm/ashr shrinkage of the interaction coefficients. QC is thorough (library sizes, VST PCA by condition and time, distance heatmap, cross-tab, no-silent-drop policy) and the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified. Normalization is only implicit in DESeq2 usage and never stated as size-factor normalization inside the model, and the enrichment step names collections and a tested-gene universe but omits collection versions and a set-size window. The report items cover design, thresholds, gene counts, and caveats but do not commit to recording package versions.
